lines.description: Boxes with magnet closure; production from December affected. Confirmed dates with delivery after 2026-12-01 move out by 6 weeks.

statements.text_en: Magnet supplier Jiangxi RareMag Materials Co., Ltd. (Ganzhou, CN) has informed PackRight that under the new licensing rules for rare-earth products its shipments of RM-N42-D0401 are suspended until a licence is granted.

verdict.summary_en: Supply notice from Guangzhou PackRight dated 2026-11-21. Its magnet supplier's shipments of RM-N42-D0401 are suspended pending a rare-earth export licence. Confirmed PR-RB-2207 dates with delivery after 2026-12-01 move out by 6 weeks. November boxes are covered by magnet stock, and printed parts without magnets are unaffected. Ferrite magnet or ribbon closures can be sampled within 10 days on request.
red_flags: Confirmed delivery dates for PR-RB-2207 after 2026-12-01 are delayed by 6 weeks.
Magnet supply (RM-N42-D0401) is suspended with no licence date given; the end of the delay is open-ended.
Only boxes already confirmed for November are covered by held magnet stock.
No new specific dates or quantities are given; the buyer must work out the revised dates itself.
Alternative closures (ferrite magnet, ribbon) would need sampling and approval.
observations: Clean digital PDF, no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
No document number, PO number or quantities given.
Opening paragraph is in Chinese and repeats part of the English text; the English text adds the part number, the November stock and the PR-RB-2207 impact.
